value.rationale: A natural operator-theoretic sharp invariant for the five-cycle has a complete nontrivial phase diagram and exact retractional witnesses. The obstruction at t=1 disappears at t=2 even though the special edge remains metrically essential until t=4. This cleanly separates retractional geometry from graph-edge redundancy and supplies a motivated finite benchmark for larger spaces, without claiming an unrestricted general theorem.
